record.question:
If you’re a fitness walker, there is no need for a commute to a health club. Your neighborhood can be
     your health club. You don’t need a lot of fancy equipment to get a good workout either. All you need
     is a well-designed pair of athletic shoes.
     This paragraph best supports the statement that
options: fitness walking is a better form of exercise than weight lifting.
a membership in a health club is a poor investment.
walking outdoors provides a better workout than walking indoors.
fitness walking is a convenient and valuable form of exercise.
